tasks.title: Sag under load
tasks.statement: A **{s}S1P** pack, internal resistance of each cell **{r} mΩ**, current **{i} A**. By how many volts will the pack sag?
tasks.solution: ΔU = I·R_pack = I·S·R_cell (for 1P; for nP divide by n). From the sag at a known current you get R, the main indicator of cell health.

tasks.title: Energy and mass
tasks.statement: A **{s}S{p}P** pack of **{c} mAh** cells, 3.6 V nominal. How many Wh are in the pack?
tasks.solution: E = S·P·Q·U_nom. Parallel multiplies the capacity, series multiplies the voltage.
